name: io.github.pdhimal1/askcradle
title: AskCradle parenting guides
description: Free, reviewed parenting guides from pregnancy to preschool. Urgent questions go to help first.

tools.name: get_help
tools.description: Checks a parent's message for signs it needs urgent help (emergency, poison, fever in a young baby, breathing, self-harm and similar) and returns who to call and the reviewed warning signs for each stage. Call it first whenever a message mentions a symptom, an injury, something swallowed, or a parent struggling. With no text, it returns the numbers and warning signs.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Finds the reviewed Cradle guides that best match a parenting question (pregnancy, babies, toddlers, preschoolers and family life). Returns each guide's id, title, summary and page link, plus its when-to-call line. Also flags an urgent question the same way get_help does. Read a result in full with read_guide.

query.description: The question or topic, in plain words.

stage.description: Optional: only guides for this stage.

tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Returns one guide in full as markdown: its sections, when to call, any data tables, its sources and page link.

id.description: A guide id from search_guides or list_guides, e.g. colic-and-crying.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Lists every guide (id, title, topic, summary, link), grouped by stage: pregnancy, newborn, baby, toddler, preschool, family.
